# Blume Studios

> Immersive VR, live game experiences and interactive exhibits on Post St in Charlotte, NC. Rated 4.9 from 558 Google reviews.

- Type: Association / Organization
- Address: 904 Post St, Charlotte, NC 28208, USA
- Phone: (704) 372-1000
- Website: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/blume-studios/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=5983084611346964991&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQQAhgEIAA
- Google rating: 4.9 from 558 reviews


## About
Blume Studios is a large space in Charlotte where you don't just watch the show, you step inside it. Past guests have put on VR headsets, played a live version of a board game and walked through an interactive space exhibit.
The space gets decorated for whatever theme is running, so it looks different from one visit to the next. We're rated 4.9 from 558 Google reviews.

## Services
- Life Chronicles: A VR experience where one reviewer said a personal VR holographic agent guided them through it.
- Monopoly Live: A live game experience in a space decorated for the theme.
- Infinite: A space interactive exhibit one guest called top tier and very professional.

## FAQ
Q: Is there parking?
A: Yes. A reviewer said parking is ample, free and adjacent to the venue.

Q: Does the experience change?
A: It does. The space is decorated for the current theme, so check what's running before you come.

Q: I've never tried VR. Is it worth it?
A: One reviewer who came back for another visit recommended giving VR a try and said it was worth the experience.

## What customers say
- "Another Great Experience at Blum Studios!

This was our third visit to Blum Studios, but our first time experiencing “Life Chronicles.” We had previously experienced the Space Station VR, so we were excited to see what had changed—and WOW, what a difference!

If you’ve never experienced VR (Virtual Reality), we would both highly recommend giving it a try. Yes, it’s a little expensive, but in our opinion, it’s absolutely worth the experience.

What really impressed us was how much the technology has advanced in just 18 months. This time, we had our own personal VR holographic agent guiding us through the experience, making it feel even more immersive and interactive.

It’s amazing to see how quickly this technology is evolving, and we’re already planning our next visit!

Once again, Blum Studios does not disappoint. This is definitely a HIGH RECOMMEND! 👍" (Paul St Germain, 5/5)
- "We were here for the “Infinite” space interactive exhibit and it was an absolute treat. The overall space is huge and the experience was top tier and very professional." (Taylor Moss, 5/5)
- "Played Monopoly Live! The space is nice, decorated for the current theme. All employees were very nice and helpful! Can't wait to see what they do next." (Kendra Steele, 5/5)
- "Start with parking- ample, free, adjacent to the venue.

Location of venue- easy in easy out area is in gentrification mode.

External signs? Minimal from a distance… down a dead end street.

Went to see a wine tasting comedy show “IN POUR TASTE “. It was ok.  Much like a high school play/show or a weak improv. The whole setup is amateurish. Premium seating for two is $100 more and nobody can really tell you what you’re receiving for the extra.

So to break things down the show is in the corner of a large warehouse.  Some weird shop area, over priced wine bar& some strange displays.  Restrooms are strange like fancy port-a-potties.

The show itself was meh. The wine ok but minimal pours. Nobody could tell you much about the wines other than the sommelier that was part of the show.

The premium seat was two rows in front of the general seating. Nothing more.

Honestly the people in back seemed to have a better experience." (S R, 4/5)
